# Connections Curaçao

> Electronics retailer in Willemstad, Curaçao, with stores in Punda and Otrobanda. Phones, laptops, accessories, audio, device repairs, second-hand phones, trade-ins and digital gift cards.

Official website: https://connectionscuracao.net/
Business email: info@connectionscuracao.net
Main phone and WhatsApp: +599 9 678 2619.
Serving customers in Curaçao. Established in 1998.

Punda: Ruyterkade 28, Punda, Willemstad, Curaçao. Phone: +599 9 678 2619.
Otrobanda: Bredestraat 12, Otrobanda, Willemstad, Curaçao. Phone: +599 9 691 2424.
Both stores publish Monday–Saturday opening hours of 09:30–18:00; closed Sunday. Check with the store for holiday changes.

Product brands featured on the website include Apple, Samsung, HP, Anker and JBL. Stock, model, condition, storage, price and warranty terms require confirmation with the team. Prices are displayed in Caribbean guilders (XCG).

Suave payment options are available in store, subject to approval and current terms. The homepage states a 3% processing fee. See the Suave page and confirm the applicable fee and final plan before purchase.

The Starlink page provides independent plan information and hardware enquiries. Starlink manages and bills the internet subscription separately.

Information reviewed: 24 October 2026. Linked pages and the store team provide current availability and terms.
